name: Performance Factors 1
definition: Performance factors of the investment fund / fund class.

CorporateActionFactor.name: Corporate Action Factor
CorporateActionFactor.definition: Value of the NAV before all corporate events of the valuation date, divided by the value of the NAV after the corporate event.

CumulativeCorporateActionFactor.name: Cumulative Corporate Action Factor
CumulativeCorporateActionFactor.definition: Value of the NAV before a corporate event, divided by the value of the NAV after the corporate event, accumulated for a number of corporate events over the defined period of time.

AccumulationPeriod.name: Accumulation Period
AccumulationPeriod.definition: Period of time for the calculation of the cumulative corporate action factor.

NormalPerformance.name: Normal Performance
NormalPerformance.definition: Normal performance value of the NAV.

AccumulationPeriodRule.definition: AccumulationPeriod must be present if CumulativeCorporateActionFactor is present.
